# aamin-ui — Agent Guide

RTL-first **Arabic fintech dashboard kit**: Vue 3.5 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind v4 + shadcn-vue (reka-ui). Dark-first **dim** theme: brand blue `#015B91` as primary over dim-navy surfaces tinted with the brand navy `#002F5D`'s hue (`success` stays mint green). **Template-repo model**: consuming projects clone this repo and own the source — there is no npm package. If you are building a product screen in a project cloned from this template, this file is your contract; depth lives in [docs/](docs/).

New project setup → **[docs/registry.md](docs/registry.md)** (shadcn-vue registry, preferred) or **[docs/new-project.md](docs/new-project.md)** (template clone).

## Hard rules (lint-enforced or convention — never violate)

1. **Logical utilities only.** `ms-*/me-*/ps-*/pe-*/start-*/end-*/text-start/border-s/rounded-s…` — never physical. ESLint `vue/no-restricted-class` ERRORS on: `/^(ml|mr|pl|pr)-/`, `/^-?(left|right)-\d/`, `text-left`, `text-right`, `/^border-l(-|$)/`, `/^border-r(-|$)/`, `/^rounded-l-/`, `/^rounded-r-/`. Details: [docs/rtl.md](docs/rtl.md).
2. **Every digit run goes inside `class="num"`** (mono, tabular, LTR-isolated): amounts, dates, IDs, counts, percentages, phone numbers. Money only via `src/lib/money.ts` (3 decimals shown, truncated, exact 5 on hover only when different, never compacted; `formatCompact` for chart axes only). Dates only via `src/lib/datetime.ts` (lists `formatDateYmd` + `formatTimeAgo`; detail stamps `formatDateTime`; day groups `formatTimeHm`; never inline `slice`/`replace`). Contracts: [docs/money-and-status.md](docs/money-and-status.md).
3. **Directional glyphs** (arrows, chevrons pointing "forward/back") get `cn-rtl-flip` or an `rtl:` variant. Vertical icons (sort arrows, up/down trends) never flip.
4. **Every UI string (incl. aria-labels) goes through vue-i18n keys.** Kit strings live in `src/locales/<lang>/<namespace>.json` (one file per namespace, ar/en starter values; kit-owned — don't edit them, the registry overwrites them). Project strings and overrides of kit strings go in `src/locales/<lang>/app.json` (merged last; also holds the `app.name`/`app.title` identity). Add locales via `LOCALES` in `src/lib/locales.app.ts` (project-owned; re-exported by `src/lib/i18n.ts`) plus a `src/locales/<code>/` folder. Every icon-only button still needs an `aria-label` (via a key). Code identifiers and comments are English.
5. **Icons from `@lucide/vue`, imported only via `@/lib/icons`** (lint-enforced) — swapping icon libraries is a one-file change. No other icon package.
6. **Colors via theme tokens only** (`bg-primary`, `text-success`, `border-destructive`…). Never raw hex/oklch inside components — rebranding must be a token-file edit. Tokens: [docs/theming.md](docs/theming.md).
7. **Direction is owned by `useLocale()` (locale → dir); never toggle `dir` alone.** `useDir()` stays the reka `ConfigProvider` feed (already wired through `ConfigProvider :dir` in `src/App.vue`). Never hardcode `dir` on containers. Exceptions that MUST stay `dir="ltr"`: PIN/OTP inputs and chart plot areas. Mixed-script text (filenames, codes) is wrapped in `<bdi>`.
8. **`glow-primary` at most once per screen** (the single primary action), plus the persistent sidebar identity.
9. **Money/PIN confirmation goes through `PinConfirm`** — never re-inline `PinInputRoot` scaffolding outside `PinConfirm.vue` and the login OTP step. See [docs/money-and-status.md](docs/money-and-status.md).

## Commands

| Command | What |
|---|---|
| `npm run dev` | Vite dev server on **port 3100** |
| `npm run check` | lint + typecheck + tests — the gate; must be green before any commit |
| `npm run build` | `vue-tsc -b && vite build` — production gate |
| `npm run test` | Vitest (jsdom) only |

## Component inventory

### `src/components/ui/` — 43 primitive families (shadcn-vue, source-owned)

Standard shadcn-vue APIs apply **except where the trap list below says otherwise**. One line each:

| Family | Use for |
|---|---|
| accordion | Collapsible FAQ/detail groups (one or many open) |
| alert | Static in-page notices — variants incl. `success`/`warning`/`info` (use sonner for transient events) |
| alert-dialog | Irreversible-action confirmation (destructive variant on the action) |
| avatar | Initials-based user/entity chips (no external images in demos) |
| badge | Short status/tag chips — variants incl. `success`/`warning` (kit additions) |
| breadcrumb | Path navigation (used by PageHeader's `breadcrumbs` prop) |
| button | All actions; sizes incl. `xs`, `icon-xs/sm/lg`; one primary per screen |
| calendar | Single-date picking — Libya-configured (see trap list) |
| card | Content containers; `CardHeader/CardContent/CardTitle` |
| chart | Unovis charts with token colors; `ChartTooltipContent` `showTotal` (values via `.num` + Latin digits); plot area inside `dir="ltr"` |
| checkbox | Multi-select; tri-state via `"indeterminate"` |
| collapsible | Hide secondary detail without tabs |
| combobox | Searchable select — Arabic-normalized search (see trap list) |
| command | Command palette (⌘K wired in the topbar via CommandMenu) |
| dialog | Focused short tasks; close on success |
| dropdown-menu | Contextual row/entity actions; destructive last after separator |
| form | vee-validate Field family — see [docs/forms.md](docs/forms.md) |
| input | Text fields; pair with Label; errors via `aria-invalid` |
| input-group | Input with inline-start/end addons (currency, icons) |
| label | Always above the field |
| native-select | OS-native select for dense forms/mobile |
| number-field | Bounded numeric input with steppers |
| pagination | Page controls for non-DataTable lists; `show-edges` on long lists |
| pin-input | OTP/PIN slots — only inside PinConfirm/login (rule 9) |
| popover | Light interactive overlay anchored to an element |
| progress | Determinate progress — logical-direction fill; `modelValue: null` = indeterminate (see trap list) |
| radio-group | Single choice among few visible options |
| range-calendar | From→to date range — Libya-configured like calendar; `layout`+`yearRange` add month/year header dropdowns |
| scroll-area | Custom scrollbar for long lists in bounded space |
| select | Standard styled select for fixed option sets |
| separator | Horizontal between sections, vertical between siblings |
| sheet | Side panel (drawer); side resolves from direction |
| skeleton | Loading placeholders mimicking final content shape |
| sonner | Toasts (`toast.success/info/error` from `vue-sonner`) |
| spinner | Loading glyph, sizes sm/default/lg — see [docs/async.md](docs/async.md) |
| switch | Immediate on/off; RTL thumb fix applied (see trap list) |
| table | Presentational table parts (DataTable composes these) |
| tabs | Parallel same-kind content, ≤5 tabs; animated TabsIndicator (see trap list) |
| tags-input | Multiple short values; Enter adds |
| textarea | Auto-growing multiline (field-sizing) |
| toggle | Single pressed/unpressed button |
| toggle-group | One-or-many selection from a short always-visible set |
| tooltip | Mandatory on icon-only buttons (with Arabic aria-label) |

| DocNo | Document number ("INV-2026-0042"): root is a `<bdi>` (Latin codes stay one LTR run in RTL), only the digit runs get `.num`; `wrap` | [docs/money-and-status.md](docs/money-and-status.md) |
| TotalsStrip | List totals over the WHOLE filtered set: `totals: { currency, items: { label, value }[] }[]`, one StatCard row per currency, `dimmed` while refetching | [docs/money-and-status.md](docs/money-and-status.md) |

| TimeField | THE 24-hour time control: `HH:MM` model, hour grid by part of day + minute steps + typed time (Arabic digits ok) — never a native `type="time"` | [docs/forms.md](docs/forms.md) |

| LookupChipBoard | A one-field vocabulary as editable chips (inline rename, ✕ remove, dashed add chip); host persists via `create`/`rename` `done(ok)` callbacks and confirms `remove` | [docs/forms.md](docs/forms.md) |
| BrandMark | Logo tile for a brand/provider/merchant: image edge to edge, else the name's first letter on a token tint picked from `seed` (string or number); exports `toneFor`/`letterFor` | [docs/money-and-status.md](docs/money-and-status.md) |
| ChartState + chart-theme.ts | ChartState: per-chart async gate (skeleton → error+retry → «no data» → slot). chart-theme.ts: `CHART_CONTAINER_STYLE` (Unovis `--vis-*` → kit tokens), `useChartDuration` (reduced motion), Latin-digit axis formatters, escaped `tooltipHtml` | [docs/async.md](docs/async.md) |
| DaybookList | Day-grouped ledger/activity feed: caller-supplied `kinds: Record<string, { icon, tone, sign }>` (never inferred from labels), money via money.ts, `dayKey()` day groups, day badge `dayTotal: "net"` (default — signed Σ sign×|amount|, toned; 0 shown) `| "turnover" | "count" | "none"` (net/turnover hidden on mixed-currency days; `showDayTotal` deprecated), CompactPager, `loading`/`refreshing`/`error` | [docs/async.md](docs/async.md) |
| AttachmentViewer | In-app viewer dialog for `{ id, name, url, mime }[]` (`v-model` = id on show, null = closed): images + PDFs inline, «open in a new tab» for the rest; ←/→ step the set, swapped by direction | [docs/async.md](docs/async.md) |
| NotificationBell / NotificationFeed | Topbar bell for the `#notifications` slot: `NotificationAdapter { fetchCount, fetchList, markRead, markAll }` prop (no URLs inside), polls the count via usePoll (`pollMs`), `eventIcons`/`eventTones`/`resourceIcons`/`flipEvents` maps. Feed = the popover body, usable standalone. No Tooltip on the trigger (reka nesting bug) | [docs/async.md](docs/async.md) |
| StickySubmitBar | Sticky intake footer: `stats` + `#stats`/`#alert`, cancel + the screen's one primary action (spinner + `busyLabel` while `busy`). Pair with `useLeaveGuard(busy)` | [docs/async.md](docs/async.md) |
| EmptyState | `empty \| loading \| error` panel with retry; `bare` drops the frame inside framed containers | [docs/async.md](docs/async.md) |
| Sparkline | Tiny inline trend line (SVG); `endDot`, `labels[]` hover chip; flat-dash fallback under 2 points | [docs/async.md](docs/async.md) |
| PageHeader | Page title block: `breadcrumbs`, `back` (bool or path), description, `#title`/`#meta`/`#actions` slots + detail-page actions recipe | [docs/money-and-status.md](docs/money-and-status.md) |
| AppSidebar / AppTopbar / CommandMenu / ThemeToggle / LocaleToggle / BlankLayout (`src/layouts/`) | The app shell — fixed placement in every project: topbar end cluster `[notifications slot] · LocaleToggle · ThemeToggle · user menu` (each wrapper carries `data-shell-slot`); blank pages (login, 404) get a top-end `LocaleToggle · ThemeToggle` corner from `BlankLayout`. Extend via `src/lib/nav.app.ts` (project sidebar groups) and the topbar `#notifications` slot. Don't fork, don't move | [docs/new-project.md](docs/new-project.md) |

`src/components/app/showcase/` is internal to the `/components` reference page.

### `src/composables/`

| Composable | Use for | Docs |
|---|---|---|
| usePoll.ts | Interval polling with consecutive-failure auto-stop | [docs/async.md](docs/async.md) |
| useLeaveGuard.ts | `useLeaveGuard(busy, message?)` — while busy, confirm in-app navigation (route components) and block tab close/reload | [docs/async.md](docs/async.md) |
| useAsyncJob.ts | queue→poll→done\|failed job state machine (report exports…) | [docs/async.md](docs/async.md) |
| useTheme.ts | Dark/light mode singleton (`useColorMode` hoisted) | [docs/theming.md](docs/theming.md) |
| useLocale.ts | UI language singleton (persisted, driven by `LOCALES`); owns direction + `<html lang>` and syncs vue-i18n | [docs/rtl.md](docs/rtl.md) |
| useDir.ts | rtl/ltr singleton feeding `ConfigProvider` + `<html dir>` — written only by `useLocale` | [docs/rtl.md](docs/rtl.md) |

`src/lib/utils.ts` exports `cn()` and `normalizeArabic()` (hamza/tashkeel-tolerant search normalization). `src/lib/nav.ts` is the **single source of truth** for sidebar groups AND the ⌘K palette; it is kit-owned — the project's own groups go in `appGroups` in `src/lib/nav.app.ts` (project-owned), which nav.ts reads.

UI-pure formatting lib (no Vue, no i18n — safe anywhere): `src/lib/money.ts` (`formatMoney`, `moneyFigure`, `moneyTitle`, `formatAmountCell`, `formatCount`, `formatCompact`, `parseApiNumber`, `moneySizeClass`…), `src/lib/datetime.ts` (`formatDateYmd`, `formatLocalDateYmd/Input`, `formatDateTime`, `formatTimeHm/Hms`, `formatTimeAgo`), `src/lib/digits.ts` (`toLatinDigits`, `cleanTyped` — Arabic-digit/invisible-mark-tolerant typed input), `src/lib/phone.ts` (`normalizeLibyanPhone`, `isLibyanPhone`), `src/lib/number-words.ts` (`amountInArabicWords`). Contracts: [docs/money-and-status.md](docs/money-and-status.md).

## Divergences from stock shadcn (trap list)

You know shadcn-vue; this kit deliberately differs. Assuming upstream behavior here causes real bugs:

- **Icons** go through `@/lib/icons`. Kit icons live in `src/lib/icons.ts` (kit-owned, overwritten by updates); add project icons in `src/lib/icons.app.ts` (`export { X as XIcon } from "@lucide/vue"`), which icons.ts re-exports. Registry consumers keep `iconLibrary: "lucide"` in `components.json`.
- **Everything is physical→logical codemodded.** Never paste upstream shadcn diffs verbatim — re-apply the logical-utility conventions (rule 1) to any newly generated component.
- **badge** has extra `success` and `warning` variants (soft tinted, matching `destructive`'s pattern).
- **switch** carries an `rtl:` negated thumb-translate fix — upstream's physical `translate-x` breaks in RTL. State selectors are `data-[state=checked]/[state=unchecked]` (what reka 2.x actually sets), NOT `data-checked:`.
- **progress** fills by logical `width` in a flex track. Do NOT reintroduce upstream's `translateX(-N%)` — it fills the wrong side in RTL. `modelValue: null` renders an indeterminate animation (`animate-progress-indeterminate` keyframe in `style.css`, sliding on logical `inset-inline-start`, frozen under reduced motion).
- **tabs** auto-renders reka's animated `TabsIndicator` inside `TabsList`. Its position uses physical `left`/`translate-x` from reka's `--reka-tabs-indicator-*` vars ON PURPOSE (reka measures the DOM directly) — do NOT codemod these to logical properties. The indicator is written as **arbitrary properties** (`[width:var(--reka-tabs-indicator-size)]`, `[translate:var(--reka-tabs-indicator-position)]`, `[left:0]`) so a registry consumer's shadcn-vue CLI (`rtl: true`) doesn't rewrite `translate-x-*` into a broken `rtl:` twin — keep that spelling.
- **select** is restyled like dropdown-menu: `position="popper"` / `align="start"` / `sideOffset` 4 by default, `rounded-xl p-1 shadow-lg`, start-edge focus bar, primary check, trigger ring + rotating chevron. There is deliberately **no** popper `data-[side=*]:translate-*` (it doubled the offset) and no `cn-menu-translucent`; don't reintroduce either. `item-aligned` still works but is no longer the default.
- **select** root (`Select.vue`) is keyed on the i18n locale, so it remounts on a language switch — reka's `SelectItemText` copies the selected item's text into the trigger only once on mount. Don't add per-call `:key="locale"`; a label that changes for any OTHER reason (renamed option, async-loaded labels) still needs a caller-side `:key`.
- **combobox** has a flush search row (`InputGroup` `h-10 rounded-none border-0 border-b`), and re-exports `ComboboxVirtualizer` from reka for long lists.
- **tabs** `TabsList` is a phone strip below `sm`: no wrap, snap scrolling, **hidden scrollbar** (a bar under tabs reads as a second underline — don't use `scroll-x` here), end-edge fade mask (dir-aware, per-direction gradients because `to inline-end` is not valid in `mask-image`), and the active trigger auto-scrolls into view (MutationObserver on `data-state`, `behavior:'auto'` under reduced motion). All strip utilities are gated on `group-data-horizontal/tabs:` so vertical lists render as before; triggers are `shrink-0 snap-start`.
- **sonner** requires `import "vue-sonner/style.css"` (already in `Sonner.vue`) — v2 ships CSS separately; toasts are invisible without it. The toaster corner is direction-aware, and rich-colors are remapped to kit tokens (`--success`/`--warning`/…) in `Sonner.vue`.
- **calendar / range-calendar** are Libya-configured: `locale="ar-LY-u-nu-latn"` (Latin digits, explicit) + `:week-starts-on="6"` (Saturday). Keep both when copying the demos.
- **combobox** demos use `ignore-filter` + a `normalizeArabic()` computed — reka's built-in substring filter can't match أ/إ/آ/ا or ة/ه equivalences. Copy that pattern for any Arabic search.
- **Base CSS forces `email/tel/url/number` inputs LTR** (right-aligned) under RTL via a `style.css` rule — do not add per-input `dir="ltr"` hacks.
- **chart** plot areas render inside `dir="ltr"` (time axis flows left→right; sanctioned rule-7 exception); labels and tooltips stay token-colored with `.num` values.
- **pin-input** slots keep `dir="ltr"` and `.num` (digits read left-to-right even in Arabic UI).
- **pin-input** root is a bare `w-fit` slot row (no frame/padding) — center it with `mx-auto` (or a centering parent); slots are `h-8 w-8` and grow to `sm:h-9 sm:w-9`.
- **button** has soft-tint status variants `success` / `warning` / `info` (info uses `chart-2`) for resolve/undo/route action rows. They are NOT a second primary — they carry no glow; `glow-primary` rules (rule 8) are unchanged.
- **dialog**: `DialogContent` caps at `max-h-[min(90dvh,calc(100dvh-2rem))]` with `overflow-y-auto` and `p-4 sm:p-6`. For edge-to-edge sections pass `p-0` on the content and use `<DialogFooter bleed>` (own inset, tinted `border-t`) instead of copy-pasting the footer treatment. The close button's sr-only label is `t("common.close")`. alert-dialog content is `max-w-[calc(100%-2rem)]` so it never touches viewport edges on phones. The command palette dialog keeps its top-third anchoring and adds `max-h-[min(80dvh,32rem)]`.
- **scroll-area** viewport carries `max-h-[inherit]` — a root with only a `max-h-*` now scrolls instead of spilling (percentage height against an auto-height parent resolves to auto).
- **toggle-group** defaults `orientation="horizontal"` so reka renders `data-orientation` (the item rounding variants `data-horizontal`/`data-vertical` depend on it); flush groups would otherwise render square.
- **Custom utilities** live in `src/style.css`: `num`, `row-number` (the `#` gutter cell), `glow-primary`, `bg-grid`, `bg-halo`, `scroll-x`, `cn-rtl-flip`, `cn-shake` (reduced-motion-safe). They are `@utility` definitions — available like any Tailwind class. (`animate-progress-indeterminate` is a `@theme` keyframe, used by Progress's indeterminate mode.)

## Working on the kit itself

- **Count invariant** (test-enforced): the `badge` string in `src/lib/nav.ts` must equal the number of `src/components/ui/*` folders, and the ComponentsPage header text must match. Adding/removing a ui family means updating both (currently 43).
- **Docs drift test** (`src/__tests__/docs.spec.ts`): every ui family, app composite, and composable must be mentioned in this file, and every `docs/*.md` must be linked from here. Adding a component without documenting it fails `npm run check`.
- Conventions tests: `src/__tests__/conventions.spec.ts` (style.css utilities, router integrity) and `rtl-conventions.spec.ts` (globs source for physical utilities).
- **Registry** (`registry.json`, `registry/` output, generator + e2e in `scripts/registry/`; guide: [docs/registry.md](docs/registry.md)): after changing kit code run `npm run registry:build` and commit the result — the drift test in `src/__tests__/registry.spec.ts` fails otherwise. Run `npm run registry:e2e` (slow, ~10 min, needs network) before releases — it runs the documented public `init --preset …/registry/r/starter.json` flow against a local raw-GitHub stand-in (no token anywhere). ## The schema-form pattern (copy this)

```ts
import { useForm } from "vee-validate";
import { toTypedSchema } from "@vee-validate/zod";
import { z } from "zod";

const schema = toTypedSchema(z.object({
  posName: z.string().min(1, "اسم نقطة البيع مطلوب"),
  phone: z.string().regex(/^09\d{8}$/, "رقم ليبي يبدأ بـ 09"),
  amount: z.number().min(1, "الحد الأدنى دينار واحد"),
}));

const { handleSubmit, resetForm } = useForm({ validationSchema: schema, initialValues: { … } });
const onSubmit = handleSubmit((values) => { /* typed values */ });
```

Template side uses the `ui/form` Field family (`FormField` + `FormItem/FormLabel/FormControl/FormMessage`) — error messages are the Arabic strings from the zod schema, wired to `aria-invalid` + `aria-describedby` automatically.

## Rules

- **Error messages are Arabic** and live in the schema, not the template.
- **Label above the field, always** (`Label` / `FormLabel`); hint or error below.
- Manual (non-schema) fields still wire `aria-invalid="true"` + a `text-destructive` hint linked by `aria-describedby` — see the inputs section of ComponentsPage.
- Search inputs: icon absolutely positioned `start-2.5`, input padded `ps-8`.
- Amount/numeric inputs get `class="num"`; `input-group` supplies currency addons.

## Field-type guide

| Need | Use | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Fixed option set | `select` | `native-select` for dense/mobile contexts |
| Searchable options (Arabic) | `SearchableSelect` (single) / `MultiSelect` (many) | Replaces "copy the combobox demo" — see below |
| Bounded quantity | `number-field` | min/max/step; steppers + wheel |
| Single date | `DateField` | Never a native `type="date"` — see below |
| Time of day | `TimeField` | Never a native `type="time"` — 24-hour `HH:MM` |

## DateField / TimeField — never native date/time inputs

Native `type="date"` / `type="time"` render browser chrome (`mm/dd/yyyy`, AM/PM) that follows the browser's locale, not ours. Use the kit controls:


## Arabic-tolerant search (raw combobox and anywhere you filter Arabic text)

SearchableSelect/MultiSelect already do this. For a hand-built combobox, reka's built-in filter is plain substring — it can't equate أ/إ/آ/ا or ة/ه. The kit pattern (ComponentsPage combobox section):

```ts
import { normalizeArabic } from "@/lib/utils";
const filtered = computed(() => {
  const needle = normalizeArabic(search.value);
  if (!needle) return options;
  return options.filter((o) => normalizeArabic(o.label).includes(needle));
});
```

with `ignore-filter` set on `<Combobox>` so your computed list is the single source of truth. Typing `اسواق` must match `أسواق`.

This kit is a **template repo** for ALAMANTECH projects (all rights reserved — see README): a project clones it, owns its copy of the source, and builds the product inside it. The guardrails (ESLint RTL guard, tests, tokens, conventions) travel with the clone — keep them.

- `npx degit ALAMANTECH/aamin-ui my-app` (no git history), then `git init`.

```bash
cd my-app
```

**To start a new page:**

1. Copy the matching template into `src/pages/`.
2. Rename the `templates.*` i18n keys to your feature's keys.
3. Change the route constants to your feature's routes — `DETAIL_PATH` in the list template, `LIST_PATH` in the detail template (they point at `/reference/templates/*`, which does not exist in production builds).
4. Replace the marked `/* ---- Data … ---- */` block with your real data source — your data layer (a fetch composable / query hook) feeding DataTable's server-mode props. The kit ships no data layer; see [datatable.md](datatable.md) for server mode.
5. Delete the `previewState` prop and the `data-anatomy` attributes (they only feed the anatomy overlay).
6. Register the route with a `titleKey` and add the nav item to `appGroups` in `src/lib/nav.app.ts`.

The anatomy page renders either template inside a frame that repeats the shell's page gutters, with a **Show measurements** switch that outlines and labels every measured value live (gutters, header→content gap, section gaps, card padding, grid gaps), a state picker (ready / first load / refreshing / error / empty), and the two spec tables below. `ANATOMY` in `PageAnatomyPage.vue` is the source of truth; `src/__tests__/pages.spec.ts` fails if a class value there is missing from this file.

## The rules

1. **One `PageHeader` per page** (`src/components/app/PageHeader.vue`) — the page's only `<h1>`. Title `text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight sm:text-2xl`; `description` under it; `#title` when the title is more than text (a document number); `#meta` for a detail page's identity lines; `#actions` at the end edge.
2. **Breadcrumbs from the nav root.** Every page passes `breadcrumbs`, starting at the nav root (`{ label: t("nav.home"), to: "/" }`), then each parent list, ending at the current page (no `to`). Detail pages also pass `back` = the parent list path (an arrow with `cn-rtl-flip`).
3. **At most one `glow-primary` per page** — the single primary action in `#actions`. Its label hides on phones (`<span class="max-sm:hidden">`) and the button keeps an Arabic/English `aria-label`. Everything else is `variant="outline"`/`ghost`.
4. **Detail actions recipe:** primary (glow) · two everyday actions `variant="outline" class="max-md:hidden"` · a "More" `DropdownMenu` (`size="icon"`, `aria-label` = `common.more`) holding the rest — and, on phones, the two everyday ones (`class="md:hidden"` items + separator). Destructive item last, after a separator.
5. **Page spacing tokens** — the page root is `space-y-6` (header → content, block → block); an overview of headed sections is `space-y-8`; a detail page's body below the header is `space-y-4`. Never invent a gap — pick from the spacing table.
6. **Section heading style** — `<section class="space-y-3">` with `<h2 class="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold">` and an icon `size-4 text-primary` (`aria-hidden`). Section cards: `CardHeader class="pb-2"` + `CardTitle class="text-sm"`, fact rows `flex items-baseline justify-between gap-4 py-2 text-sm` inside `CardContent class="divide-y"`.
7. **States, in this order:** first load → skeletons **in the final shape** (list: `h-9 w-full sm:w-64` search + `h-9 w-24` end control + a bordered box of `h-9` rows; detail: four `h-28` tiles, a `h-9 w-72` tab strip, a `h-64` panel) → nothing loaded and an error → `EmptyState state="error"` with retry → loaded but empty → the DataTable `#empty` slot with `<EmptyState bare>` (filtered vs. never-had-data wording, with "clear filters" or the create action) → refreshing → the table dims (`opacity-40 transition-opacity`, `aria-busy`) under a centered `Spinner size="lg"`.
8. **List toolbar** (DataTable `#toolbar`): search form (`sm:w-64` input + secondary submit whose label hides on phones) → `FilterSheet class="xl:hidden"` with stacked fields / the same fields inline `max-xl:hidden` → `DataTableViewOptions` pushed to the end (`ms-auto`) → `FilterChips class="order-last basis-full"`. On phones the DataTable draws the toolbar as a tinted band bled to the screen edges and the rows as ledger cards (column `meta.mobile`: `title` / `trailing` / `stat` / `hidden`).
9. **Tabs ride the URL** — `?tab=` (the default tab leaves it out), synced both ways; panels `pt-4`, inactive panels unmount. Below `sm` the kit's `TabsList` is a full-width snap strip (no wrapper needed).
10. **Responsive behavior** — gutters grow `px-3 → sm:px-4 → md:px-8`; header title + actions share one row from `sm`, phones keep icon-only primary; stat grids go 1 → `sm:grid-cols-2` → `xl:grid-cols-4`; side-by-side splits wait for `lg`; table columns drop with `meta.class` (`max-md:hidden`, `max-lg:hidden`, `max-xl:hidden`).
11. **Digits, money, dates** — every digit run in `.num`; money through `Amount` / `MoneyFigure` / `StatCard` (`src/lib/money.ts`); dates through `src/lib/datetime.ts`; document codes through `DocNo`; statuses through `StatusBadge`.
12. **No hardcoded UI text** — every string through `useI18n()` keys, in both `src/locales/ar/` and `src/locales/en/` (project strings in `app.json`).

# The @aamin registry — install the kit with the shadcn-vue CLI

Besides the template-clone flow ([new-project.md](new-project.md)), the kit is published as a **shadcn-vue registry** named `@aamin`. A product project is a normal `shadcn-vue` Vite app that pulls the kit's source in through the CLI — you own the files after they land, and you can pull a single updated component later.

- The registry lives in this repo: `registry.json` (the item list, generated) and `registry/r/*.json` (one built file per item, served from `main` over `raw.githubusercontent.com`).
- The repo is **public**: no token, no login, no extra headers. The `@aamin` registry entry in a consumer's `components.json` is just the raw URL.
- Always run the CLI as **`npx shadcn-vue@2.7.4`** (the version the registry is built and tested with).
- Registry consumers keep **`rtl: false`** in `components.json` (set by the starter). The kit's sources are already logical-utility RTL; the CLI's own RTL transform would corrupt them.

## 1. New project from the registry

PowerShell:

```powershell

cd my-app
npm pkg set scripts.dev="vite" scripts.build="vue-tsc -b && vite build" scripts.preview="vite preview" scripts.typecheck="vue-tsc -b --noEmit" scripts.lint="eslint ." scripts.test="vitest run --passWithNoTests" scripts.format="prettier --write src" scripts.check="npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test"
# optional, recommended (step 3):
npx shadcn-vue@2.7.4 add @aamin/reference -y
Remove-Item src/assets/index.css
npm run dev
```

bash:

```bash
npx shadcn-vue@2.7.4 init -t vite -n my-app --preset https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ALAMANTECH/aamin-ui/main/registry/r/starter.json -y
cd my-app
npm pkg set scripts.dev="vite" scripts.build="vue-tsc -b && vite build" scripts.preview="vite preview" scripts.typecheck="vue-tsc -b --noEmit" scripts.lint="eslint ." scripts.test="vitest run --passWithNoTests" scripts.format="prettier --write src" scripts.check="npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test"
# optional, recommended (step 3):
npx shadcn-vue@2.7.4 add @aamin/reference -y

npm run dev
```

The first `npx` run of a version asks `Ok to proceed? (y)` before downloading the CLI — answer `y` (or run `npx --yes shadcn-vue@2.7.4 …`).

What each step does:

1. **`init … --preset <starter.json URL>`** creates the stock shadcn-vue Vite app and applies `@aamin/starter` to it as the preset: the consumer `components.json` (Tailwind v4 paths, aliases, `rtl: false`, and the `@aamin` registry entry), the whole kit (all `ui` families, the app composites, composables, `lib/`, locales ar + en, the app shell, the layouts, `AGENTS.md` + `docs/`), and the project config (vite/vitest/eslint/tsconfig, `index.html`, `.gitignore`) — replacing the template's own versions of those files. It also installs the npm dependencies. It does **not** include the dev-only reference pages (step 3).
2. **`npm pkg set …`** adds the npm scripts (registry items cannot add scripts). The same command works in both shells. `check` = lint + typecheck + tests; tests are not shipped, so `test` passes with no test files.
3. **Optional, recommended: `add @aamin/reference -y`** — the dev-only living reference (section 6). The project's `AGENTS.md` points agents at these pages (`/reference/components`, the page templates, the recipes), so install it unless you have a reason not to. Right after the init every shared file is identical, so `-y` runs without prompts. Production builds never include it.
4. **Remove the template's leftover `src/assets/index.css`** (dead CSS the starter never imports). Delete the `src/assets/` folder too if nothing else is in it.
5. `npm run dev` and open the printed URL (port 3100). `npm run check` must be green.

Then read the `AGENTS.md` that landed in the project root — it is the contract for building screens ([new-project.md](new-project.md) sections 2–5 apply: rebrand, shell placement, recipes).

### Expected noise during `init` / `add`

The CLI prints **about 80 `Failed to transform imports in <file>` warnings, each with a long stack trace**. They are expected and harmless: CLI 2.7.4 runs an import resolver over every written file by its name and cannot parse JSON/Markdown/HTML/dotfiles as TypeScript. The files are still written **verbatim** (byte-identical to the kit). Warnings for `.vue`/`.ts`/`.css` files would be a real problem — report those.

### An existing shadcn-vue project

To pull single `@aamin/*` items into a project that was not created from the starter, add the registry entry to its `components.json` (the consumer config is also published as `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ALAMANTECH/aamin-ui/main/registry/components.json`):

```json
"registries": {
  "@aamin": { "url": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ALAMANTECH/aamin-ui/main/registry/r/{name}.json" }
}
```

and keep `"rtl": false`. The kit's conventions (tokens in `src/style.css`, i18n setup, the `@/lib/icons` barrel) come with the starter, so most items expect it.

## 2. Pinning a release

The init command above tracks `main`. To pin a tag instead, replace `main` with the tag (`…/ALAMANTECH/aamin-ui/<tag>/registry/r/starter.json`) in the `--preset` URL, and in `components.json` replace `main` with the same tag in the `@aamin` registry URL (`…/ALAMANTECH/aamin-ui/<tag>/registry/r/{name}.json`) — the starter's config always points at `main`. Later `add`s then read that tag until you move it.

## 3. Your strings and app name

Locale JSON is split per namespace: `src/locales/<lang>/<namespace>.json`. The kit's namespace files (`common.json`, `datatable.json`, …) are **overwritten by updates** — never edit them for your product. Everything of yours goes in **`src/locales/<lang>/app.json`** (app name and title, page strings), which only `@aamin/starter` ships (as a small starting point). Single-item updates never touch it; do not re-apply the starter (`add @aamin/starter --overwrite`, or another `init --preset`) on a project that has begun — it would reset `app.json` and the app entry files. Add languages via `LOCALES` in `src/lib/locales.app.ts`.

## 4. Adding or updating one item

Items are named `@aamin/<name>`: one per `ui` family (`button`, `dialog`, …), one per app composite (`data-table`, `stat-card`, `pin-confirm`, …), plus `lib-*`, `use-*`, `locale-*`, `shell`, `agents-docs`, `starter` and `reference`. The full list is the `items` array in `registry.json` in the kit (or the files in `registry/r/`). Dependencies between items resolve automatically.

```bash
git add -A && git commit -m "before kit update"      # commit first: add --overwrite replaces files
npx shadcn-vue@2.7.4 add @aamin/data-table --overwrite -y
git diff                                              # review exactly what the kit changed
```

Unchanged files stay clean, so re-adding an up-to-date item produces an empty diff. If you customized a file the item ships, `git diff` shows the collision — restore your parts (section 5). Run `npm run check` afterwards.

## 5. What updates overwrite

`add @aamin/<x> --overwrite` rewrites **every file of `x` and of all its dependencies** (transitively — `@aamin/data-table` alone pulls in `lib-i18n`, `lib-icons`, several `ui` families and locale files). So the files are split by owner:

| Kit-owned — rewritten by updates, never edit for your product | Project-owned — shipped once by `@aamin/starter`, never by an update |
|---|---|
| `src/components/ui/**`, `src/components/app/**` | `src/lib/icons.app.ts` — your icons (`@/lib/icons` re-exports them) |
| `src/lib/*.ts` (incl. `icons.ts`, `nav.ts`, `i18n.ts`), `src/composables/**` | `src/lib/nav.app.ts` — your sidebar/⌘K groups (`appGroups`) |
| `src/locales/<lang>/<namespace>.json` (kit namespaces) | `src/lib/locales.app.ts` — `LOCALES` (your languages) |
| `src/layouts/**`, `src/pages/NotFoundPage.vue` (`@aamin/shell`) | `src/locales/<lang>/app.json` — your strings + overrides of kit strings |
| `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/*.md` (`@aamin/agents-docs`) | `src/pages/HomePage.vue` and every page you add |
| `src/pages/reference/**` (`@aamin/reference`) | `src/router.ts`, `src/main.ts`, `src/App.vue`, `src/style.css` (tokens), `index.html`, `vite.config.ts`, the tooling config |

Re-applying the starter on a started project resets the project-owned column too — don't. After **any** `--overwrite`, review `git diff`; where the kit replaced a deliberate local change, put your hunks back interactively (commit before updating, so there is something to restore from):

```bash
git checkout -p -- <file>      # y = restore your hunk, n = keep the kit's
```

Without `--overwrite`, `add` asks per changed file instead (even with `-y`): answer `n` to keep yours.

The registry is generated from the source tree — never hand-edit `registry.json` or `registry/`.

1. Change the kit; `npm run check` green (a drift test fails if the committed registry no longer matches the source).
2. `npm run registry:build` — regenerates `registry.json` and `registry/r/*.json` + `registry/components.json` (kept out of `public/`, so kit builds never ship them).
3. Optional but recommended before a release (about 10 minutes, needs network): `npm run registry:e2e` — runs the section 1 flow against a local server that mimics public GitHub raw (the exact `init --preset` command, with the host swapped), then the consumer's build, check, update workflow and the reference install. It never commits in the kit repo. `AAMIN_REGISTRY_BASE=https://raw.githubusercontent.com npm run registry:e2e` runs the same flow against the published registry instead (after a push).
4. Commit `registry.json` + `registry/` together with the change.
5. Push to `main` (consumers read `main`). Tag a release (`git tag v1.2.0 && git push --tags`) so projects can pin it.

Generator and e2e live in `scripts/registry/`; which source files belong to which item is declared in `scripts/registry/items.config.mjs`.

# RTL playbook

Arabic is this kit's first language; LTR is the secondary direction. Every component must render correctly in BOTH — the language toggle in the topbar (`LocaleToggle`) switches locale and direction together, live.

## How direction flows

- **Locale owns direction.** `useLocale()` (`src/composables/useLocale.ts`) holds the persisted UI language. Each entry in `LOCALES` (`src/lib/locales.app.ts`, re-exported by `src/lib/i18n.ts`) declares its `dir`; one module-scope `watchEffect` pushes the chosen locale into vue-i18n, its `dir` into `useDir()`, and its code into `<html lang>`. Switch language with `useLocale().set(code)` / `toggle()` — **never write `dir` alone**, or direction and language drift apart.
- **Locale files.** `src/lib/i18n.ts` merges `src/locales/<code>/*.json` per locale code; the kit-owned namespace files merge first and `app.json` (project-owned) merges last, so a project overrides kit strings without editing kit files.
- `useDir()` (`src/composables/useDir.ts`) is a module-scope singleton — a plain, **non-persisted** `ref` (the persisted source is the locale, which rewrites it on every load) — holding `dir: "rtl" | "ltr"`, mirrored onto `<html dir>` by a module-scope `watchEffect`. Read it (it feeds `ConfigProvider`); don't toggle it.
- `src/App.vue` wraps the app in reka-ui's `<ConfigProvider :dir="dir">` — **this is what makes every reka primitive (selects, menus, sheets, pin inputs…) direction-aware**. Without it they'd all render LTR. Never remove it; never hardcode `dir` on containers.
- CSS logical properties do the rest: `ms-*` = margin-inline-start = right in RTL, left in LTR.

## The lint guard (why your physical class errors)

`eslint.config.ts` sets `vue/no-restricted-class` to **error** with these patterns:

```
/^(ml|mr|pl|pr)-/   /^-?(left|right)-\d/   text-left   text-right
/^border-l(-|$)/    /^border-r(-|$)/       /^rounded-l-/   /^rounded-r-/
```

A physical utility renders mirrored-wrong in one of the two directions — always. There are no exceptions; if you think you need `left-0`, you need `start-0`.

## Cheat table (physical → logical)

| Never | Always |
|---|---|
| `ml-* / mr-*` | `ms-* / me-*` |
| `pl-* / pr-*` | `ps-* / pe-*` |
| `left-* / right-*` | `start-* / end-*` (also `-start-*` negatives) |
| `text-left / text-right` | `text-start / text-end` |
| `border-l / border-r` | `border-s / border-e` |
| `rounded-l-* / rounded-r-*` | `rounded-s-* / rounded-e-*` |
| `translate-x-*` for direction-dependent movement | `rtl:` variant pair (see switch) or `cn-rtl-flip` |

## The three text/glyph tools

- **`.num`** (`@utility num` in `src/style.css`): mono font, `tabular-nums`, LTR-isolated. Wrap EVERY digit run — `12,400`, `2026-07-10`, `TX-84921`, `+18.2%`, phone numbers. Without it, digits jumble inside Arabic text.
- **`cn-rtl-flip`**: mirrors a glyph under RTL (`scaleX(-1)`). For direction-semantic icons: back/forward arrows, prev/next chevrons (`ChevronLeftIcon class="cn-rtl-flip"`). Do NOT flip vertical or symmetric icons (sort arrows, trends, plus, search).
- **`<bdi>`**: isolates mixed-script runs so Latin filenames/codes don't scramble surrounding Arabic — `<bdi class="truncate">{{ file.name }}</bdi>` (see FileDropzone).

## Form-input direction

`src/style.css` has a base rule: under `[dir="rtl"]`, `input[type=email|tel|url|number]`, `input.num`, and `textarea.num` get `direction: ltr; text-align: right` — Latin-content fields type correctly while staying visually right-aligned. **Do not** add per-input `dir="ltr"` hacks; the base rule covers it. PIN/OTP inputs are the exception that carries explicit `dir="ltr"` (inside PinConfirm).

## Component-level RTL fixes already in place (don't undo)

- **switch**: thumb translate uses paired `rtl:` negated variants — upstream's physical translate escapes the track in RTL.
- **progress**: fills via logical `width` in a flex track (inline-start anchored) — not `translateX`.
- **sheet**: drawer side resolves from `dir` (`side="dir === 'rtl' ? 'right' : 'left'"` in `DashboardLayout`).
- **sonner**: toast corner is direction-aware.
- **calendar/range-calendar**: nav arrows mirror via `cn-rtl-flip`; week starts Saturday; Latin digits (`ar-LY-u-nu-latn`).

## Verifying RTL work

1. `npm run check` — `src/__tests__/rtl-conventions.spec.ts` globs `src/components/ui` + `src/pages` for banned physical utilities.
2. In the browser (dev server, port 3100): toggle direction from the topbar and eyeball the screen in BOTH directions — labels on the correct side, chevrons mirrored, digits stable.
3. For geometry bugs (a thumb/fill on the wrong side), measure with `getBoundingClientRect()` against the container rather than trusting screenshots.

# Theming & tokens

Dark-first "brand-blue-on-dim-navy" identity (primary = brand blue `#015B91`, hue ~245; the dark theme dims its surfaces with the brand navy `#002F5D`'s hue and lightens the same blue for its primary). Every color in the kit resolves through CSS variables in `src/style.css` — **rebranding a consuming project is a token-file edit; components never change.**

## Architecture (Tailwind v4)

`src/style.css` is the single theme file:

1. **`:root { … }`** — light theme tokens as oklch CSS variables (`--background`, `--foreground`, `--primary`, `--success`, `--warning`, `--destructive`, `--muted`, `--accent`, `--border`, `--ring`, `--card`, `--sidebar*`, `--chart-*`, `--radius`…).
2. **`.dark { … }`** — the same token set, dim-navy values (surfaces tinted with the brand navy hue, lighter than the background for layering). Dark is the design-primary theme.
3. **`@theme inline { … }`** — maps the variables into Tailwind, so `bg-primary`, `text-success`, `border-destructive`, `ring-ring`, etc. exist as utilities with full opacity-modifier support (`bg-primary/10`).
4. **`@utility` blocks** — the kit's custom utilities:

| Utility | What |
|---|---|
| `num` | Mono + `tabular-nums` + LTR isolation for digit runs |
| `glow-primary` | The signature brand glow — max once per screen (primary action) |
| `bg-grid` | Subtle grid texture (empty states, dropzones, 404) |
| `bg-halo` | Radial halo behind the main scroll area |
| `scroll-x` | Horizontal-only overflow with a thin indicator-style scrollbar (StatCard long amounts) |
| `cn-rtl-flip` | Mirrors a glyph under RTL |
| `cn-shake` | Rejected-PIN shake; no-op under `prefers-reduced-motion` |

`@theme inline` also defines `animate-progress-indeterminate` (keyframes sliding on the logical `inset-inline-start`, frozen under reduced motion) — it powers `Progress`'s indeterminate mode.

5. **Base rules** — RTL input direction (see [rtl.md](rtl.md)), focus-visible, scrollbar styling.

## Theme switching

`useTheme()` (`src/composables/useTheme.ts`) is a module-scope singleton over `@vueuse/core`'s `useColorMode` (initial `dark`: **dark-first** — a first-time visitor gets dark regardless of their OS setting; the choice persists once toggled, and `toggle()` flips dark↔light. To follow the system until the user picks, change `initialValue` to `"auto"` in `useTheme.ts`). The `ThemeToggle` topbar button and the SettingsPage appearance cards share the same instance — reuse `useTheme()`, never instantiate `useColorMode` yourself.

`index.html`'s `theme-color` meta matches the dark background (`#101924` = precise sRGB of `oklch(0.21 0.025 253)`).

## Rules for component code

- Use semantic utilities only: `bg-card`, `text-muted-foreground`, `border-border`, `text-success`… Never `bg-[#22c55e]`, never `text-green-500`, never inline oklch.
- Charts/sparklines take CSS variables as paint: `color: var(--chart-1)` / `var(--destructive)` (see `Sparkline.vue` usage in `StatCard.vue`).
- Status colors: `success` (mint-green family, hue ~166 — deliberately distinct from the blue brand primary), `warning` (amber), `destructive` (red) exist as tokens AND badge variants — map statuses via `StatusBadge`, not ad-hoc classes.
- One deliberate exception exists: SettingsPage's theme-preview swatches hardcode the *opposite* theme's colors (live vars can't express that); it's commented there. Don't add new exceptions.

## Rebranding checklist (consuming project)

1. Edit `:root` + `.dark` variable values in `src/style.css` (primary hue, radius, chart palette).
2. If you swap fonts: update the font-family stack in `style.css` and self-host the files.
3. Run the dev server and check `/reference/components` in BOTH themes and BOTH directions — every component reads from the tokens, so the whole kit recolors at once.
4. `npm run check` — the conventions test asserts the token names still exist (don't rename tokens; change values).
